description: A man in a dark work shirt with rolled sleeves leans over a long wooden case resting on two trestles, its open top showing rows of strings and small jacks. He holds a quill to the mechanism with one hand and a small tool with the other, lit by a candle on a bench behind him. The workshop has hand planes, chisels and a shelf of tools, with wood shavings on the floor, in a dark oil-painting style. A tiny light mark sits in the bottom-right corner; the painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
